summary: In Ratchet, Menara Voidrender asks warlocks to find Robes of Arcana for a garment meant to bear powerful enchantments.

sections.title: A Vessel of Arcana
sections.body: Menara Voidrender asks warlocks seeking greater power to bring her a set of Robes of Arcana. She wants a garment strong enough to hold dark magic. The strength of a magical relic depends on the skill, rarity, and effort put into its materials. Ordinary rags would fail under deep enchantments, so the robe must be finely made and ready to receive them.

sections.title: Craft and Ambition
sections.body: Menara admires warlocks who can weave the robe themselves, but ambition matters more to her than pride. You can sew the silk, commission a skilled artisan, or buy the robe at market. However you obtain it, the finished garment is ready to become a specialized tool of fel mastery.

faq.q: Why does Menara Voidrender need Robes of Arcana specifically?
faq.answer: Powerful enchantments need a garment made with skill and rare materials. Menara uses the Robes of Arcana as a receptive foundation for the forces she plans to bind into it.
Menara Voidrender lives in Ratchet, the goblin port in the Barrens. She instructs warlocks who want to advance their craft and make specialized gear.

faq.q: Do I have to tailor the Robes of Arcana myself?
faq.answer: No. Menara respects the work of making the robe yourself, but accepts one acquired through trade or bought from another craftsman. You can secure it by any practical means.

faq.q: Where does the pattern for Robes of Arcana come from?
faq.answer: The pattern is rare and can be found among cultists and dark casters. Dark Strand Voidcallers at the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore and Defias Enchanters in Duskwood are among those who carry it.

faq.q: What happens to the Robes of Arcana after handing them in?
faq.answer: Menara takes the robes as material for the imbuing ritual that follows. If you wear them when you bring them to her, she removes them at once, leaving you without a chestpiece until the later steps are complete.

faq.q: What is the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe?
faq.answer: The Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe is a specialized garment for mid-ranking warlocks. Dark components and protective enchantments strengthen its wearer's resilience and reserves of dark energy.

angles.text: As a warlock, making the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe teaches you to build powerful artifacts on a strong, carefully prepared foundation.
As a tailor, you need the rare pattern for Robes of Arcana and skill with spider's silk and many bolts of fine silk.
As Forsaken, you may travel far to the sun-bleached Barrens to learn from Menara and strengthen your frail mortal husk against your volatile arts.
As an Orc warlock, gathering materials for subtle robes offers you a quieter way to master fel energy, away from prying eyes and the shadow of your race's demonic past.
